![RAGLab: RAG From Scratch](/projects/rag-from-scratch/screenshot.png){.project-banner}

The first project in a benchmarking monorepo where I build the same RAG problem more than once, each project taking a different set of tradeoffs so those tradeoffs stay visible instead of hidden behind a library's defaults. This one is the baseline: no RAG framework, no vector-database service — just a flat NumPy index with brute-force cosine similarity, word-window chunking, and prompt assembly, all provider-agnostic via `litellm`. A CLI (`ingest` / `ask` / `demo`) ingests a text file and answers questions grounded in it, narrating each pipeline step — chunk, embed, retrieve, generate — as it happens. See the [full writeup](/posts/raglab/rag-from-scratch/) for the architecture and design tradeoffs.
